name: Straumann Holding AG
summary: Straumann Holding AG provides tooth replacement and orthodontic solutions in Switzerland, the United States, China, Germany, Brazil, Japan, France, and internationally. It operates through Sales Europe, Middle East and Africa; Sales North America; Sales Asia Pacific; Sales Latin America; and Operations segments. The company offers dental implants, instruments, CADCAM prosthetics, orthodontic and clear aligners, biomaterials, and digital equipment and solutions for use in tooth correction, replacement, and restoration, as well as to prevent tooth loss.
